A4I Lab (IIIT-B x Microsoft) 

Organization: A4I Lab (IIIT-B x Microsoft) 

Location: IIIT Bangalore 

Type: Contract (through March 2027, extendable) 

Experience: 4 to 7 years 

About A4I Lab 

AI Innovation and Inclusion Initiative (A4I) is a partnership between Microsoft and IIIT-B, working with non-profit partners to apply AI to real-world challenges in education, healthcare, accessibility, and agriculture. 

Role Overview 

We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong mobile development expertise to help build AI-powered applications for large-scale, real-world deployments. You will work across mobile engineering, AI integration, and release management to create reliable and accessible user experiences. 

What You Will Do 

• Build and maintain applications using Flutter, React Native, or native Android with Kotlin. 

• Integrate AI services such as LLM APIs, speech tools, and vision capabilities. 

• Design offline-first mobile experiences for low-connectivity environments. 

• Manage app releases, deployments, and versioning workflows. 

• Implement Firebase analytics, crash reporting, and push notifications. 

• Build multilingual and accessible mobile interfaces. 

• Collaborate with AI engineers, designers, and partner teams. 

Required Qualifications 

• 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience including production mobile applications. 

• Experience with Flutter, React Native, or native Android development. 

• Hands-on experience integrating AI or ML services into applications. 

• Experience with Firebase services and release management workflows. 

• Working knowledge of APIs, backend integrations, and collaborative engineering practices. 

• Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience building multilingual or Indic-language mobile applications. 

• Familiarity with TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, or ONNX Runtime Mobile. 

• Experience with accessibility-focused mobile development. 

• Exposure to offline-first architectures and field deployments. 

How to Apply

Please send your resume to a4i@iiitb.ac.in

Subject line: Application for AI Engineer – Mobile Applications

A4I Lab is committed to building AI systems that serve everyone. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, disciplines, and geographies.
